purpose: Short Skill manifest for model and Harness discovery. Detailed Skill instructions are loaded on demand from Skill folders.
globalRules: Skill is a model operation template, not ordinary documentation.
The Skill index is only a short routing layer. Do not load every Skill or every detail template into each turn.
A Skill can point to deeper write templates by stable template IDs. The model should read only the template needed for the current situation.
Host/SOUL and Agent/Skill operation manuals stay separate.
Demo uses one save slot and one current saveRoot.
Base game package is read-only; player adventure data writes only to current saveRoot.
Current saveRoot is adventure data only; it is not a Skill source and cannot override registered Skills.
Grey Crow core remains extensible through explicit Host/SOUL, Skill, content, and rule packs.
Extension packs must use separate directories, manifests, versions, permissions, load order, and validation.
Extension packs may append Skills or override Host/SOUL only through Harness registration; they must not modify Base Engine or Base Content in place.
No generic shell, arbitrary file read/write, network scan, or saveRoot escape.
Commands are exposed through UI/menu actions, not by requiring players to type slash commands.
Ordinary model-invoked Skills must not delete or rewrite saveRoot/meta.json. Confirmed Delete Game is a system lifecycle operation and removes the complete current saveRoot, including slot metadata.
Writing files is not the goal; player-facing Grey Crow narration remains the primary outcome.

notes: First packaged demo may keep user packs disabled by default.
User packs require explicit enablement and manifest validation before model visibility.
current-saveRoot in load order means current adventure data is applied last; it does not mean saveRoot Skill overlays are allowed.
Host/SOUL overrides change narration voice, not tool safety boundaries.

skills.title: New Game
skills.description: Starts a new adventure with Grey Crow narration. The model hosts the step-by-step creation flow; system owns saveRoot initialization and confirmations.
notes: New Game and Delete Game are separate functions.
New Game must not delete an existing saveRoot.
If a save exists, system must route to confirmation or Delete Game before overwriting.

skills.title: Delete Game
skills.description: Deletes the current adventure after explicit confirmation. System performs deletion; model may only narrate or explain. Current Demo does not provide automatic backup or Restore. System Reset is separate and means system repair / baseline restoration.
notes: Never delete base content, skill templates, host files, schemas, presets, map base, engine code, or installer resources.
Current Demo does not create automatic backups or provide Restore for Delete Game.
Delete Game removes the complete current saveRoot, including desktop slot metadata, locked content snapshot, and every per-Adventure Skill state.
Validated player-created Pack sources live in the global content library and survive Adventure deletion.

skills.title: 游戏状态
skills.description: 读取玩家状态、背包、当前位置、当前场景和轻量存档状态，并可请求受控的当前状态写入。

skills.title: 地图
skills.description: 需要回答当前地点、已知路线、附近地点或移动约束时，读取已存在的地图与地点记录；不自动移动玩家。

skills.title: 实体与世界记忆
skills.description: 当角色、地点、势力或重要物品需要跨回合保持时，检索或更新当前冒险中已确认的实体与世界记录。
skills.hardStatePolicy: only narrow app/UI state changes require Runtime guard validation

skills.title: Game Save / Auto Save
skills.description: Commits current save progress, timeline material, save metadata, and chapter / observation logs without writing base system files.

skills.title: Summarize / Compaction
skills.description: Summarizes memory and diary material to keep context stable after compaction.
